Speciality hospitals.name: Single-specialty care providers
Speciality hospitals.description: These companies run hospitals, clinics and centres built around one clinical area such as child care, eye care, joint replacement, cancer, dialysis, fertility or neurodevelopment. They earn per procedure, treatment or stay, and the narrow focus sets them apart from multi-specialty chains.

extra.name: Medical device and consumables makers
extra.description: These companies make and sell medical devices, labware, dental and surgical products, and diagnostic kits to hospitals, labs and consumers. They earn from product sales, and margin depends on manufacturing scale, regulatory approvals and export demand.

extra.name: Contract research and life-science services
extra.description: These companies provide research, testing, analytics and engineering services to drug and life-science firms, and earn project or service fees. They serve companies rather than patients, which sets them apart from hospitals and labs.

value_chain.description: These chains run big tertiary hospitals in metro and large cities, earning from inpatient and outpatient treatment. They treat complex cases such as cancer, transplants and cardiac surgery. Margin depends on occupancy, case mix, insurance tariffs and how quickly new beds mature.
